Yuval Ezra, son of Tania and Haim, was born on the 19th of Menachem Av 5758 (11 August 1998) in Galia. He is the brother of Daniel and Ariel Avraham.

On 20 March 2017 he enlisted in the IDF and served in the Artillery Corps.

Major Yuval Ezra fell in battle on the 10th of Menachem Av 5786 (24 July 2026), at the age of twenty-seven. He was laid to rest in the military section of the cemetery in Beit Dagan. He is survived by his parents and his brothers.
